{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-run analysis with explicit printing of all required numbers

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999].copy()
print(f'After removing biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_clean)} rows')

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')
print(f'After deduplication (keep highest sample_seq): {len(df_dedup)} rows')

# Step 3: Convert assay_batch B biomarker_final from µg/L to ng/mL
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup["assay_batch"] == 'B', "biomarker_final"] /= 10

# Step 4: Stratify by severity and compute response rates
stratum_results = []
for severity in df_dedup["severity"].unique():
    subset = df_dedup[df_dedup["severity"] == severity]
    n_treatment = subset[subset["arm"] == "treatment"].shape[0]
    n_control = subset[subset["arm"] == "control"].shape[0]
    responded_treatment = subset[(subset["arm"] == "treatment") & (subset["responded"] == 1)].shape[0]
    responded_control = subset[(subset["arm"] == "control") & (subset["responded"] == 1)].shape[0]
    
    prop_treatment = responded_treatment / n_treatment if n_treatment > 0 else 0
    prop_control = responded_control / n_control if n_control > 0 else 0
    
    treatment_effect = prop_treatment - prop_control
    
    stratum_results.append({
        "severity": severity,
        "n_treatment": n_treatment,
        "n_control": n_control,
        "prop_treatment": prop_treatment,
        "prop_control": prop_control,
        "treatment_effect": treatment_effect
    })

stratum_df = pd.DataFrame(stratum_results)
print('\nStratum-specific results:')
print(stratum_df)

# Step 5: Compute weights from total patients in each stratum
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
stratum_totals = df_dedup["severity"].value_counts().sort_index()
stratum_weights = stratum_totals / total_patients

print('\nStratum weights:')
print(stratum_weights)

# Step 6: Compute weighted average treatment effect
weighted_effect = (stratum_df["treatment_effect"] * stratum_weights).sum()
print(f'\nWeighted average treatment effect: {weighted_effect}')"}
